peace_action_modifiers = {
	aaa_core_cheap = {
		category = is_core
		peace_action_type = take_states
		enable = { ROOT = { tag = AAA } FROM.FROM.FROM = { is_core_of = ROOT } }
		cost_multiplier = 0.5
	}
	bbb_defends = {
		category = treaties_or_conferences
		peace_action_type = { take_states puppet }
		enable = { ROOT = { original_tag = BBB } }
		cost_multiplier = 1.5
	}
	ccc_only = {
		peace_action_type = puppet
		enable = { CCC = { exists = yes } }
		cost_multiplier = 0.9
	}
	generic_claim = {
		category = has_claim
		peace_action_type = take_states
		enable = { FROM.FROM.FROM = { is_claimed_by = ROOT.FROM } }
		cost_multiplier = 0.9
	}
}
